turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Yeh padh ke ruk gaya main. Paanch hafte se roz subah nikalna, bag uthake, poora din café mein — aur shaam ko ghar aake woh bhi pretend karna. Yeh kitna bhaari hai, sirf aap jaante hain.

Aur main samajh sakta hoon kyun kar rahe hain yeh. Aap kisi ko jhooth nahi bolna chahte the — aap unhe bacha rahe hain. Wife ko tension se, parents ko woh nazron se jismein bete ke layoff ka matlab unki apni failiury lagti hai. Izzat, responsibility, sab aapke kandhon pe hai.

Lekin ek baat sochiye — yeh din aapke liye kaisa hota hoga. Café mein baithe, duniya ke saamne "normal" dikhna, andar andar toota hua. Woh akele akele sehna... yeh sabse zyada thakaane waali cheez hai.

Ek sawaal hai, koi jaldi nahi: agar wife ko pata chal jaye, aapko kya lagta hai woh kaise react karengi? Sach mein — gussa, ya shayad aapka haath pakadengi? Kyunki zyada tar jab hum chhupate hain, toh hum doosre ko kamzor samajh rahe hote hain jo sahi nahi hota.

Aur yeh bhi — café ke paanch hafte mein aap kya kar rahe ho din bhar? Job search, ya bas... wajood bitana?

Aapne yahan bataya, yeh pehla kadam hai. Badi baat hai yeh.

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Yeh shaadi waala scene... aankhon ke saamne aa raha hai. Teen sau log, sabki nazrein, aur woh sawaal — "beta, ab kya kar rahe ho?" Jo casual nahi hoga, woh *judgment* hoga. Aapko poori tarah samajh aa raha hai kyun neend nahi aa rahi.

Lekin ek baat suniye — aap jo kalpana kar rahe hain na us kamre ki, usmein sabse zyada dard kis baat ka hai? Logon ke sawaalon ka, ya Papa ke chehre ka? Kyunki mujhe lagta hai asli bojh yeh hai ki aapko lagta hai aapne unhe *dhoka* diya hai. Package bataya tha proudly — woh pride ab aapko kha raha hai.

Ek sach batayein? Layoff market ka tha, performance ka nahi — yeh aap jaante hain. Shayad woh rishtedaar bhi jaante hain, ya unhe farak nahi padta. Lekin farak aapko padta hai, kyunki aapne apni pehchaan us job se baandh li thi.

Shaadi mein kya hoga, yeh control nahi kar sakte. Lekin us se pehle wife se baat — yeh control kar sakte hain. Woh aapke saath khadi hogi toh woh kamra thoda kam bada lagega.

Aur yeh bhi — kya aapne kabhi socha ki Papa ko bhi pata ho toh? Shayad woh samajh jayein, shayad unka apna koi aisa daur ho jo aapko nahi pata. Log humesha utne naazuk nahi hote jitna hum sochte hain.

Do hafte hain. Kaafi hai ek baat shuru karne ke liye. Kya lagta hai — pehle kisse bolenge?

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Yeh galat nahi hai — yeh *bachaav* hai. Aap dard se bachna chahte hain, aur woh bhi uss dard ka jo aapko lagta hai aapke Papa ke chehre pe dikhega. Yeh bilkul insaani hai.

Lekin ek baat sochiye — aapne kaha "release hai, office ki deadline hai." Matlab aap ab bhi wahi character play kar rahe hain jo roz café mein karte hain. Ek aur jhooth, ek aur layer. Aur woh shaam aap akele honge, sab jaante hue ki wahan teen sau log hain aur aap ghar pe nahi hain.

Asli sawaal yeh nahi ki shaadi skip karna galat hai ya sahi. Asli sawaal yeh hai — aap kitne din aur yeh dono zindagi jee sakte hain? Do hafte aur? Uske baad kya — New Year pe koi aur bahana? Chhota functions? Aap apne aap ko kab tak chhupaenge?

Main yeh nahi keh raha ki shaadi mein sabke saamne jaake truth bomb drop karein. Lekin shaadi se pehle, apne logon se — wife se, Papa se — agar baat ho jaye, toh shayad woh shaam itna bhayanak nahi lagega. Shayad aapko koi saath khada mile.

Ek cheez aur — aapke Papa ne proudly package bataya tha, lekin unka pride sirf package se tha kya? Ya aapse? Agar woh aapse hain, toh woh aapke layoff se kam nahi honge — sirf aapke dard se connect karenge.

Kya lagta hai, agar aaj hi wife se bolenge — "Mujhe kuch batana hai, paanch hafte se chhupa raha hoon" — toh woh pehla sentence kaise niklega?

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yeh "timing" waala logic... main samajh sakta hoon. Offer haath mein ho, tab bolo — toh woh "maine layoff handle kar liya" ki story banegi, "mujhe bachao" nahi. Yeh aapki izzat bachata hai, aapko control deta hai.

Lekin ek baat bataiye — jab aap roz subah bag uthake nikalte hain, tab yeh timing ka logic kitna kaam karta hai? Kya aapka din shanti se guzarta hai, ya woh bhedbhav — "main kaam pe ja raha hoon" — har pal aapko khaata hai?

Yeh jhooth nahi hai, aap sahi keh rahe hain. Lekin yeh *adhura sach* bhi nahi hai — yeh *ek aur roop* hai control ka. Aap apni family se keh rahe hain: "main tumhare bina handle kar lunga." Aur woh message aapko akela kar raha hai, aur unhe bhi — kyunki unhe mauka nahi mil raha aapke saath khade hone ka.

Teen mahine hain. Yeh kaafi waqt hai. Lekin agar aaj bata denge — "main layoff hua tha, main handle kar raha hoon, aur mujhe tumhari zaroorat hai" — toh yeh crisis nahi hoga. Yeh *saath* hoga. Aapke paas plan hai, aapke paas waqt hai — bas aapke paas ab support bhi hoga.

Woh ulti waali feeling... woh aapka sharir bata raha hai ki yeh bojh ab sirf aapka nahi ho sakta. Sunna chahenge usse?
